s4_label.heading: 5.5 Effect of P-gp Inducers and Inhibitors on Dabigatran Exposure

supporting_quote_or_value: The concomitant use of PRADAXA with P-gp inducers (e.g., rifampin) reduces exposure to dabigatran and should generally be avoided
rationale: P-gp inducers are concomitant medicines that lower dabigatran exposure; the label says to avoid them.
uncertainty: The risk is loss of effect (lower exposure), not a new adverse reaction. Same passage names impaired renal function, a patient factor, which is a different class. Scoped to SPL 9ac0a64a-8666-45f7-9d4f-40fd894f7e6d v7 (effectiveTime 20250627) and this passage only.
